one_liner: Ranks every number by its rate in the last 52 draws minus its rate in all earlier draws.
registry_status_reason: Released by package REL-1 (releases and WF-1 design v0.1r1, owner decisions WF1-1 and WF1-2, ratified 31 October 2026). Contract runs on real data need the separate real-development gate.
short_explanation: E_10 looks at each number on its own. It compares each number's rate in the last 52 draws (about a year) with its rate in all earlier draws, so its highest-ranked numbers are those rising fastest and its lowest-ranked those falling fastest. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 104 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
